---
title: "Correlation chord"
description: "Visualize selected correlation relationships as a chord diagram."
---

## Purpose

A correlation chord diagram is useful for a **filtered subset** of relationships among proteins, traits, pathways, metabolites or other variables. It becomes difficult to interpret when every possible pair is displayed.

## Recommended workflow

1. Start from a numeric matrix or correlation table with stable variable names.
2. Choose the correlation method appropriate to the data.
3. Apply an effect-size threshold and, when available, a significance criterion.
4. Keep only biologically relevant relationships.
5. Draw the chord diagram and inspect whether line width/color encodes the intended statistic.
6. Export the filtered edge table used to generate the plot.

::: {.callout-warning}
Correlation does not establish causation. For high-dimensional correlation screens, p-values also require attention to multiple testing and non-independence among features.
:::
